notes: SO-101 joint-space pi0.5 fine-tune of lerobot/pi05_base (dataset yathAg/so101_pick_place). Inputs: observation.state [6] (QUANTILES-normalized, tokenized into the prompt by pi05), observation.images.camera1 + camera2 (480x640); output action [6] = JOINT_ORDER .pos. camera_map sends our wrist frame as camera1 and the left AR0144 overhead half as camera2. The training dataset's camera2 viewpoint is not documented, so camera2 = overhead_left is an assumption to check on hardware. verified_revision is informational: the bridge cannot pin a revision, so the server loads main. Evidence: vla_bridge/checkpoint_candidates.md.
